annotations.title: Look up the IMI rate of a municipality

description: Looks up the yearly IMI (municipal property tax) rate of one Portuguese municipality, by name or four-digit code, with its history by year. Use it when only the rate is needed; for the yearly amount on a VPT `imi_annual_cost`, for several municipalities side by side `compare_municipalities`. Rates are from the Autoridade Tributária portal, all 308 municipalities. Where the rate is set per parish, the answer says so instead of giving a number.

municipality.description: Municipality name (Porto, Lisboa or Lisbon, Vila Nova de Gaia) or its four-digit code (1312)

name: imi_rate

anyOf.description: Refusal (isError: true). `error` is a machine code (not_found, bad_*, tool_failed…), `message` says what to fix.

outputSchema.description: Success, or a refusal with an error code. Units: *_cents euro cents, *_eur euros, *_eur_m2 euros per m², *_pct and percent in percent.

title: Look up the IMI rate of a municipality
